hero.description: A registered youth welfare association from S. Sankaralingapuram, Madurai District, working quietly and steadily for education, health, relief and community upliftment since our founding.

about.title: Rooted in Community, Guided by Purpose
about.intro: Annapparavai Ilaignar Nalasangam is a village-level youth welfare association built on the belief that lasting change begins with people who choose to serve where they stand.

history.title: Our History
history.body: Formed by a group of young residents of S. Sankaralingapuram who wanted to give back to their village, our association was registered under the Societies Registration framework as Reg. No. 71/2026. What began as informal volunteer efforts around local festivals and relief work has grown into a structured organisation with a standing executive committee and regular community programmes.

mission.title: Our Mission
mission.body: To organise the youth of our village towards consistent, transparent and meaningful service in education, health, environment and welfare — and to be a dependable first responder in times of local need.

vision.title: Our Vision
vision.body: A self-reliant, united and progressive village community where every resident has access to opportunity, dignity and support — carried forward by generations of committed local youth.

objectives.title: Our Objectives
items: Promote unity and volunteerism among the youth of S. Sankaralingapuram
Support education through scholarships, tuition support and awareness drives
Organise health camps, blood donation drives and hygiene awareness programmes
Provide relief and support during floods, disasters and personal emergencies
Preserve and celebrate Tamil culture, festivals and local traditions
Maintain full transparency in registration, finances and governance

founders.title: The People Who Started It All
founders.description: Annapparavai Ilaignar Nalasangam was founded by dedicated individuals who believed a small village could achieve big change through unity.
